title: Kathu: Condos, Golf and the Road to Patong, for Renters and Buyers
excerpt: Kathu is Phuket's condo district. We list 73 homes for rent there at a median of ฿27,000 a month and 36 for sale at a median of ฿2.29 million. Where to look, what it costs, and who it suits.
author: Islander Home Team
content:
Kathu is located in the centre of the island, along the road between Phuket Town and Patong. It is home to two golf courses, Loch Palm and Red Mountain, Kathu Waterfall, and a cluster of large condominium developments just a short drive from Central Phuket. For anyone looking for a modern apartment at an affordable price, Kathu is often the first place to consider.

The figures below are based on our listings as of early November 2026.

Renting in Kathu

We list 73 homes for rent in Kathu, with a median monthly rent of ฿27,000. Most of the available properties are condominiums.

One of the most affordable places in Phuket to rent a condo. A one-bedroom unit has a median monthly rent of ฿17,500, while a two-bedroom unit has a median of ฿32,000. Most are located in the D Condo family of developments, which offer shared swimming pools, gyms and 24-hour security.

  • A one-bedroom at dcondo Reef: ฿18,000 a month
  • A two-bedroom corner apartment at The Origin Kathu: ฿35,000 a month
  • A three-bedroom house at Pruksa Ville Kathu-Samkong: ฿40,000 a month
  • A private pool villa near Loch Palm golf course: ฿80,000 a month

Who Kathu suits

  • Renters on a budget. Kathu offers some of the lowest condo rents on our list.
  • First-time and investment buyers. Most condos are priced around ฿2 to ฿2.5 million, and the larger developments are popular with tenants.
  • Golfers. Loch Palm and Red Mountain golf courses are right on the doorstep.
  • People who work in Patong or Phuket Town. Kathu is conveniently located along the road connecting the two.

The main trade-off is the distance from the beach. Kathu is inland, with Patong just over the hill and the quieter beaches further away. If you prefer to live closer to the sea, consider Rawai or Bang Tao.
